input.quote: 19.2 For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
input.rationale: Sections 19.1, 19.3, 19.4 and 19.5 are strong: professional/workmanlike services, conformance to documentation, no malicious code, compliance with Applicable Law, a repair/re-perform/replace-then-refund remedy, and a disclaimer that expressly does not swallow express warranties. The failure is duration: Section 19.2 limits the Deliverable conformance warranty to fifteen days after delivery — below the fallback minimum (90 days software / 30 days services) — and its cut-off ("after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation") extinguishes the otherwise open-ended conformance warranty in 19.1 and the remedy in 19.4. Fifteen days is also barely longer than the fifteen-business-day acceptance window in Section 6.1, leaving effectively no post-acceptance warranty coverage. The redline extends the period to ninety (90) days and deletes the cut-off, with a non-limitation cross-reference preserving 19.1/19.3 and the 6.2/19.4 remedies.

proposal.summary: Extend Deliverable conformance warranty from 15 to 90 days and remove the post-period cut-off of correction/refund duties.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the Deliverable conformance warranty to ninety (90) days, as fifteen days is shorter than our minimum warranty duration and barely exceeds the acceptance testing window in Section 6.1. We also removed the language cutting off all correction and refund obligations, since that would override the general conformance warranty in Section 19.1 and the remedy in Section 19.4.

ops.oldText: For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
ops.newText: For ninety (90) days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation. Nothing in this Section limits the warranties in Section 19.1 or 19.3 or the remedies in Sections 6.2 and 19.4.
